name: I Can't Go for That (No Can Do)

info.album: I Can't Go for That (No Can Do) (Pomo Remix)

podcast.body: This hit song prominently features the sounds of the Roland CR-78 drum machine, demonstrating its widespread use in early 1980s pop music. "It's here and I can't go for that from Hall and Oats."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History of the Drum Machine

podcast.body: This hit topped both the pop and R&B charts, establishing Daryl Hall and John Oates as the premiere blue-eyed soul act of their era. "I've chronicled how the duo of Darryl Hall and John Oates became the premiere blue-eyed soul act of their day, topping both the pop and R&B charts with I Can't Go For That."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
srcs.episode: Yes We Can Can Edition Part 1

podcast.body: This number one hit contributed to blocking Foreigner's "Waiting for a Girl Like You" from reaching the top spot on the Hot 100 for part of its ten-week run at number two. "and I can't go for that by Darryl Hall and John Oates."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
